authoring.method: Blank Studio project; shared native pen through studio_draw
authoring.optional_atlas: seed-optional-atlas.py repackages the existing blank Studio base bitmap as eq_ex.bmp. Studio paints every pixel of the new sheet.

artwork.main: Silver tabby wears oversized cyan glasses. Fish swim inside the lenses. The left fish is covered by the analyzer during playback.
artwork.equalizer: The icon cat steals a fish, with its tongue out and its tail curled beside the preamp gap.
artwork.controls: Silver Aqua chrome, blue glass transport buttons, pressed states, paw cursors, and matching collapsed windows.
artwork.playlist: The Fish List, with a Do Not Feed the DJ caption and labelled popup sprites.

webamp: mixed EQ positions and response curve
flat_area_review: The EQ paper is continuous around the cat and shared tracks. Its 24x24 flat area is intentional.
The main shell uses continuous pale silver around the cat silhouette. Its largest 17x17 flat area is intentional.
The dark sunglass lenses contain the live readouts and fish. The largest flat lens squares are 22x22 and 23x23.
The 9x9 playlist frame area matches the list palette. The footer readout areas are 9x9 and 10x10.

validation.rust_unit_suite: 432 passed; socket shutdown test failed once with macOS EINVAL and passed its isolated rerun
